# DEAD FREQUENCY — Voice-Over Recording Script

*Generated by `tools/vo_package.py` from the shipped data. 640 lines, 24 characters. Nothing has been recorded yet.*

**Delivery spec:** 48 kHz / 24-bit mono WAV, one file per line, named exactly as the `file` column (deliver WAV; the build converts to Ogg Vorbis q6). Record dry in a treated booth, 15–20 cm, pop filter. Leave 0.5 s room tone head and tail. Dialogue loudness target −18 LUFS (short-term), peaks below −3 dBFS. Processing in the `processing` column is applied in post, not in the booth. Lines tagged *the Listener wearing this voice* are recorded by the same actor as the character, a second take each, flatter, with no breaths between phrases. Drop finished files into `game/vo/` with the given names; the game uses them instead of the placeholder radio voice automatically.
